adaptive-cadence: Refreshed on an adaptive cadence: active players every few hours, dormants every weeks. Open source, no ads.
first-ever-snapshots-per-day-last-30-day: First-ever snapshots per day, last 30 days
on-demand-page-hits-enqueue: On-demand: page hits enqueue at priority 10, discovery feeds priority 0. Drained every 10s.
on-demand-page-hits-enqueue-2: On-demand: page hits enqueue at priority 10 when the cached snapshot is older than 5 min. Drained every 10s.
open-source-community-funded-numbers: Open source, community-funded. Numbers above are global (shared across all regions).
players-past-their-adaptive-refresh: Players past their adaptive refresh target plus those awaiting first snapshot. The cron drains continuously, unfetched players first.
snapshot-cadence-adapts-to-each: Snapshot cadence adapts to each player based on their last-battle recency. Active players (last 24h) refresh every 6h, dormants on longer windows up to 90 days.
